title: Check the connection
unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

practice.reviewNotice: Visual simulation: no sound, automatic count-in, hit measurement or saved results. Choose a state to inspect the screen.
practice.openInteractions: Space, the start of an active session and resuming after confirmation remain proposals. Buttons illustrate transitions; the count-in stays at 3.
practice.title: Find the pulse
practice.intro: Eight beats: five hits and three rests.
practice.sequenceHint: ● One hit · — One rest. The outline and “Now” label mark the current beat.

ready.title: Ready to start
ready.description: Listen to the model, then play the same sequence.

countdown.description: Get ready: four count-in beats before playing.

audio-error.title: Sound is unavailable
audio-error.description: Check the audio output, then try again.

loading.title: Preparing sound…
loading.description: The model will start shortly. Make sure the volume is audible.

listened.title: Your turn
listened.description: Start gives you a four-beat count-in, followed by eight beats of playing.

play.title: Play with Space
play.description: Follow the pulse and observe the rests.

missed.title: Missed
missed.description: Keep going: the next beat is coming.

extra.title: Extra hit
extra.description: Follow the pulse and observe the rests.

paused.title: Attempt paused
paused.description: Choose to continue or leave the session.

good.title: Good!
good.description: Aim a little closer to the pulse.

practice.playingHint: One key press = one hit. Keep going after a mistake.
practice.keyboardNotice: A physical keyboard is required to play, including on a tablet.
practice.exitDescription: This attempt will be interrupted and will not be saved.

results.title: Your results
results.complete: You played all five expected hits and observed the rests.
results.encouragement: Review your results, then listen or play again when you are ready.
results.local: First local exercise, without an account or session history.

practice.resumeNotice: The attempt is paused. Continue starts a four-beat count-in, then resumes at the same position.

microphone.title: Microphone test
microphone.description: Clap your hands to check detection. Choose your microphone in your browser or system settings. This test does not calculate a grade.

states.loading: Activating… Allow microphone access in your browser.
states.stopped: Microphone stopped — activate it to resume.

errors.unsupported: The microphone requires a compatible browser and an HTTPS or localhost address.
errors.denied: Microphone access was denied. Change the browser permission or close this test to play with the keyboard.
errors.missing: No microphone found. Check the selected device.
errors.busy: The microphone is inaccessible or being used by another application.
errors.lost: The microphone or audio was interrupted. Check your device, then activate the microphone again.
errors.failed: Unable to activate the microphone. Check your settings and try again.

microphone.levelHint: Adjust your distance from the microphone.
microphone.clipped: Signal clipping: move farther from the microphone or lower its gain.
microphone.sensitivityHint: Increase if hits are missed; decrease if noise or the metronome triggers hits.
microphone.processed: The browser is still applying automatic audio processing. Detection may vary.
microphone.pulseError: The metronome could not start. Check your audio output and try again.
microphone.testHint: At low volume, start the 60 BPM metronome without playing: the counter should remain steady. Then test your hits, and test the snare drum separately.
microphone.privacy: Audio is processed on this device, without recording or uploading it. The microphone stops when you close this test or hide the tab.
